contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP C VICTORINVS P F AVG] ; R/ [PAX AVG]

Copper alloy radiate probably of Victorinus (AD 269-271), reverse type Unknown probably Pax, draped, standing left, holding olive-branch or torch in right hand and sceptre positioned across the body in left hand PAX AVG. Reece Period: 13. Obverse description: Bust of Victorinus, radiate, draped, right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C VICTORINVS P F AVG]. Reverse description: Pax - probably - draped, standing left, holding olive-branch or torch in right hand and sceptre positioned across the body in left hand,. Reverse inscription: [PAX AVG]. Die axis measurement: 12 o'clock. Weight: 1.5g. Diameter: 18.1mm
